The '''Jedi Ruins''' were the ruins of ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] buildings located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="SWG:ToOW" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer visited the camp and collected a [[Taskmaster Gauss Rifle]].<ref name="SWG:RRWMIII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Rifle Weapons Mark III}}</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Ruins were a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ToOW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Jedi Ruins were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:ToOW" />
